in_sanskrit.name: Razz
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Rascal or noisy person
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Razz एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Razz is an English name derived from the word 'rascal'. It means a noisy, mischievous, or disruptive person. It can also refer to making a loud, disruptive noise or disturbance.
